body.title: Repair current persistence fixture entry points
body.summary: Remove the deleted provenance writer import and map its valid assertions to current guarded boundaries/sinks and saved artifact/history controls, preserving the complete canary matrix.
acceptanceChecks: Persistence fixture imports current modules and executes real assertions rather than failing during module loading.
Temporary task/report/checkpoint/history/trace/cache/vector canaries remain absent from durable sinks; hostile getters remain unread at boundaries that guarantee preflight rejection.
Saved artifact/history/cache/trace positive controls demonstrably persist and read back; no fake review records or resurrected writer export.
Document replacement assertion mapping; if current APIs expose an independent production defect, triage it separately and do not weaken the test or claim green.

tests.name: Temporary persistence canaries remain absent while saved artifact and history controls persist
